bugs.title: The engine peeked at the future
bugs.story: The backtest engine knew an order would expire unfilled before deciding to place it. Fixed and tested on unseen years, the edge was luck-sized.

bugs.title: A loser that passed
bugs.fake_label: pass check on the size of t
bugs.real_label: t signed in the trade's direction
bugs.story: The pass check looked at how big t was, not which way it pointed. A trade losing money at t −5.95 printed PASS.

bugs.title: A Sharpe of 4.13 that was the interest rate
bugs.story: A pair meant to be hedged had 98.9% of its money in Treasury bills. The 'edge' was just the interest they pay.

bugs.title: A placebo that found a fake lead
bugs.real_label: frozen rule, 10 stocks, out of sample
bugs.story: The fake dates were picked next to future earnings jumps. The rule built on that lead lost money in and out of sample.

bugs.title: Vendor data that couldn't be true
bugs.fake_label: first match with academic reference data
bugs.story: A $1,000,000 placeholder price, a +144,000% day, 317 trillion Seagate shares. The pipeline had to match academic data before any test could run.

bugs.title: An idea that was secretly System A
bugs.story: 75 of 96 events sat next to a month end. Take those out and nothing was left.

bugs.title: Returns added up instead of compounded
bugs.story: A tick up and back down counted as a win.

bugs.title: A month end that never happened
bugs.story: The last day in the data was treated as a month end.

bugs.title: Wins that could not lose, from a misplaced stop
bugs.story: The stop sometimes sat above the entry, so the engine booked wins labelled 'stop'.

bugs.title: The best system, costed three times too high
bugs.story: System A was charged an ETF's cost when it trades as a future. It almost got thrown away.

bugs.title: Two price files lined up by row number
bugs.story: Caught only because it disagreed with an earlier run.
